contentList.content: While toggled on, spells you cast that last until <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag> become permanent instead. Anyone affected gets the End Permanent Spells cantrip to remove them. Toggling this on or off does not change spells that are already active.
Spells this character casts that would last until <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag> are permanent.
Remove every spell on you that was made permanent by Permanent Spell. Other permanent effects are not affected.
